title: Have the website be the second player when a second player is not available.
notes: Word Fleet would just be a general opponent that talks back and forth Oregon Trail style. Other games good reveal solutions or hints based on specific puzzle.

title: Reveal-one-at-a-time device
notes:
A printable device that shows only one item at a time.

- **Dial version:** a paper sleeve with a window. Dial a letter and a number, and the window reveals what belongs at that coordinate.
- **Punch version:** punch a hole at a coordinate on the top sheet, and the answer shows through from the paper underneath.
